description: This file defines a `GalleryItem` class and a `GalleryType` enum to model media items (photos and videos) in a gallery feature, including their properties such as title, subtitle, image path, type, and optional duration label.

classes.name: GalleryItem
classes.description: Models a gallery media item with properties for type, title, subtitle, image path, and optional duration label.

methods.name: GalleryItem (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a GalleryItem instance with required properties for type, title, subtitle, and imagePath, and an optional durationLabel.
